<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="advanced-topics">
<h1>Advanced Topics</h1>
<section id="understanding-the-phase-vocoder">
<h2>Understanding the Phase Vocoder</h2>
<p>AudioSig’s time stretching uses a phase vocoder algorithm:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>STFT</strong>: Convert audio to frequency domain using Short-Time Fourier Transform</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Phase Modification</strong>: Adjust phase to change timing while preserving pitch</p></li>
<li><p><strong>ISTFT</strong>: Convert back to time domain</p></li>
</ol>
<section id="parameters">
<h3>Parameters</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="c1"># Control FFT resolution</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.2</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">n_fft</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">4096</span><span class="p">,</span>        <span class="c1"># Higher = better frequency resolution, worse time resolution</span>
    <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1024</span><span class="p">,</span>   <span class="c1"># Controls overlap between frames</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="trade-offs">
<h3>Trade-offs</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Larger n_fft</strong>: Better frequency separation, worse time precision</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Smaller n_fft</strong>: Better time precision, worse frequency separation</p></li>
<li><p><strong>hop_length</strong>: Typically n_fft // 4 for good quality</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="resampling-internals">
<h2>Resampling Internals</h2>
<p>AudioSig uses windowed-sinc interpolation:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">resample</span>

<span class="c1"># Control filter characteristics</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">48000</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">16000</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">filter_width</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">64</span><span class="p">,</span>     <span class="c1"># Wider = sharper cutoff, slower</span>
    <span class="n">rolloff</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.945</span><span class="p">,</span>       <span class="c1"># Anti-aliasing filter rolloff</span>
    <span class="n">length_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;round&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="c1"># Output length calculation</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="length-modes">
<h3>Length Modes</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'round'</span></code>: AudioSig’s default, matches historical behavior</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'ceil'</span></code>: Matches librosa’s output length semantics</p></li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">resample</span>

<span class="c1"># Compare length modes</span>
<span class="n">result_round</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">44100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">16000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">length_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;round&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">result_ceil</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">44100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">16000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">length_mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;ceil&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Round: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result_round</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Ceil: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result_ceil</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="vad-algorithm-details">
<h2>VAD Algorithm Details</h2>
<section id="normalized-energy-vad">
<h3>Normalized Energy VAD</h3>
<p>The normalized energy VAD works by:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Framing the audio into non-overlapping segments</p></li>
<li><p>Computing RMS energy per frame</p></li>
<li><p>Normalizing to [0, 1] range</p></li>
<li><p>Thresholding to detect activity</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">normalized_energy_vad</span>

<span class="c1"># The algorithm in detail</span>
<span class="n">activity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">normalized_energy_vad</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">frame_duration_ms</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">,</span>     <span class="c1"># 10ms frames = 240 samples</span>
    <span class="n">energy_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.15</span><span class="p">,</span>    <span class="c1"># 15% of max energy</span>
    <span class="n">pad_end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">,</span>            <span class="c1"># Discard trailing partial frame</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="relative-db-vad">
<h3>Relative dB VAD</h3>
<p>The relative dB VAD works by:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Computing short-time energy</p></li>
<li><p>Finding peak energy</p></li>
<li><p>Setting threshold relative to peak</p></li>
<li><p>Detecting frames above threshold</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">relative_db_vad</span>

<span class="n">activity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">relative_db_vad</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">threshold_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="c1"># 40 dB below peak</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="edge-cases-and-special-handling">
<h2>Edge Cases and Special Handling</h2>
<section id="empty-audio">
<h3>Empty Audio</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">split</span>

<span class="c1"># Empty arrays are handled gracefully</span>
<span class="n">empty</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">([],</span> <span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># trim returns empty array and [0, 0]</span>
<span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array_equal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>

<span class="c1"># split returns empty intervals</span>
<span class="n">intervals</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">intervals</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>All public transformations, including <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">time_stretch</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pitch_shift</span></code>, gain,
normalization, and resampling, accept an empty sample axis after validating
their parameters and return an empty copy with the original shape and dtype.</p>
</section>
<section id="silent-audio">
<h3>Silent Audio</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span>

<span class="c1"># All-zeros audio</span>
<span class="n">silence</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">zeros</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># With the default peak-relative reference, uniform silence remains unchanged.</span>
<span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">silence</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">top_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">24000</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array_equal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">])</span>

<span class="c1"># A fixed nonzero reference classifies the all-zero signal as silence.</span>
<span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">silence</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">top_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array_equal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>

<span class="c1"># Normalization preserves silence</span>
<span class="n">normalized</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">silence</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">normalized</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="very-short-audio">
<h3>Very Short Audio</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span>

<span class="c1"># Single sample</span>
<span class="n">single</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Time stretching works with minimum length 1</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">single</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">2.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

<span class="c1"># Pitch shifting preserves length</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">single</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">semitones</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">3.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="multi-channel-and-batch-processing">
<h2>Multi-Channel and Batch Processing</h2>
<section id="stereo-audio">
<h3>Stereo Audio</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span>

<span class="c1"># Stereo audio: (2, samples)</span>
<span class="n">stereo</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">astype</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Processing works on last axis by default</span>
<span class="n">stretched</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">stereo</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">stretched</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">2</span>  <span class="c1"># Channels preserved</span>

<span class="c1"># Can specify axis explicitly</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">stereo</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="batch-dimensions">
<h3>Batch Dimensions</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="c1"># Batch of audio: (batch, channels, samples)</span>
<span class="n">batch</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">astype</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Processing preserves batch dimensions</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.2</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">shape</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">20000</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Shorter due to rate &gt; 1</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="error-handling-strategies">
<h2>Error Handling Strategies</h2>
<section id="fail-fast-vs-fail-open">
<h3>Fail-Fast vs Fail-Open</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">AudioSignalError</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">InvalidParameterError</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">AudioShapeError</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">safe_time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fail_fast</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;Time stretch with error handling.&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">InvalidParameterError</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">e</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fail_fast</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">raise</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Warning: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">audio</span>  <span class="c1"># Return original</span>
    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">AudioShapeError</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">e</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fail_fast</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">raise</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Warning: Invalid shape: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">audio</span>

<span class="c1"># Fail-fast (default)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">safe_time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fail_fast</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Fail-open (return original on error)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">safe_time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fail_fast</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="input-validation">
<h3>Input Validation</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">AudioShapeError</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">validate_audio_input</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">expected_sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;Validate audio before processing.&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="nb">isinstance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ndarray</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">TypeError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Expected np.ndarray, got </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">type</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dtype</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float64</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Expected float32 or float64, got </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dtype</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ndim</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Audio must have at least 1 dimension&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Audio array is empty&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="performance-optimization">
<h2>Performance Optimization</h2>
<section id="memory-layout">
<h3>Memory Layout</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>

<span class="c1"># C-contiguous arrays are faster</span>
<span class="n">audio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ascontiguousarray</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Fortran-contiguous for column-major operations</span>
<span class="c1"># (not typically needed for audio)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="chunked-processing">
<h3>Chunked Processing</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_large_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_seconds</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;Process large audio in chunks.&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_seconds</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span>
    <span class="n">results</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">chunk_size</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">chunk_size</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">processed</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">results</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">processed</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">concatenate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">results</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="type-selection">
<h3>Type Selection</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>

<span class="c1"># Float32: Good for most applications, lower memory</span>
<span class="n">audio_32</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">astype</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Float64: Higher precision, more memory</span>
<span class="n">audio_64</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">astype</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float64</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Processing preserves dtype</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>
<span class="n">result_32</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_32</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.1</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Returns float32</span>
<span class="n">result_64</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_64</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.1</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Returns float64</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="integration-with-other-libraries">
<h2>Integration with Other Libraries</h2>
<section id="with-librosa">
<h3>With librosa</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">librosa</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">resample</span>

<span class="c1"># Load with librosa</span>
<span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;file.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Resample with AudioSig (NumPy-only)</span>
<span class="n">resampled</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">16000</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="with-soundfile">
<h3>With soundfile</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">soundfile</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sf</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span>

<span class="c1"># Load audio</span>
<span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;file.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Process with AudioSig</span>
<span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">top_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">normalized</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">peak</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.95</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Save</span>
<span class="n">sf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">write</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;processed.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">normalized</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="with-pytorch">
<h3>With PyTorch</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">torch</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="c1"># Convert to numpy</span>
<span class="n">audio_torch</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">audio_np</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio_torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">numpy</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">squeeze</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="c1"># Process with AudioSig</span>
<span class="n">processed_np</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_np</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.1</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Convert back to torch</span>
<span class="n">processed_torch</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_numpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">processed_np</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">unsqueeze</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="debugging-and-profiling">
<h2>Debugging and Profiling</h2>
<section id="checking-intermediate-results">
<h3>Checking Intermediate Results</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">frame_signal</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_rms</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_frames</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;Debug frame analysis.&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
    <span class="n">frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">frame_signal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">rms</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">frame_rms</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Audio length: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Number of frames: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Frame shape: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">frames</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;RMS range: [</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.4f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">, </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.4f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">]&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rms</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="performance-profiling">
<h3>Performance Profiling</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">time</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">profile_time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">iterations</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">&quot;&quot;&quot;Profile time_stretch performance.&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
    <span class="n">times</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">iterations</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">start</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">perf_counter</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">perf_counter</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">times</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">avg_time</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">times</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">std_time</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">times</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Average: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">avg_time</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.2f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> ms&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Std dev: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">std_time</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.2f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> ms&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Throughput: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">/</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">avg_time</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">/</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">1e6</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.2f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> Msamples/s&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">avg_time</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">std_time</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
